resources.string: Runs short scripts that call tools in dependency order; a separate switch that skills never turn on.
Finds MCP tools by meaning and loads their parameter definitions.
Lists the workspace, skill and MCP directories.
Reads workspace content, skills and tool definitions.
Searches the contents of workspace files.
Keeps the steps and progress of the task.
Asks a question and carries on; the answer joins a later request, and it doesn\'t wait for a reply.
Asks the user a clarifying question and waits for the reply.
Fetches web pages; hidden when the model service has its own visible search tool, unless \"Use DeepSeek Fetch when a page won\'t open\" is on.
Searches the web, with results visible to the model and in the logs; only there when the connection uses the DeepSeek Search API.
Hands slow tasks that can run in parallel to background subagents; the main agent decides whether to use it.
Waits for background subagents and returns the progress or result of each.
Stops background subagents that are no longer needed or are stuck.
Ends the task and returns the reply; required by the run protocol.
Separate from MCP and skills · saved automatically, applies to the next request · the current task is not affected
android_observe / android_action: look at the screen, tap, swipe and type; used only when there\'s no dedicated interface (opening an app or going home looks for one first too).
